a: An atom is the smallest unit of an element that retains its identity.
A molecule is two or more atoms bonded together.
Protons are positive particles in the nucleus; the number defines the element.
Electrons are negative particles that occupy shells around the nucleus.
Neutrons are neutral nuclear particles that add mass.
pH measures acidity; 7 is neutral, lower is acidic, higher is basic.
Balanced equations conserve atoms on both sides.
Covalent bonds share electron pairs between atoms.
Ionic bonds form by transfer of electrons between ions.
